note: Finding: Faithfulness, W1-W3, the spectral condition and the joint boundary distributions W_n are in Completed, but the positivity W(F*F) >= 0 is proved only for Sentences (lists of letters with one Test4 each) via Fields.sees, not for finite sequences of joint Schwartz tests in the field-word algebra. Passing from product to joint tests needs a density and continuity argument that [L] does not write.

evidence: [M] prints W^xi(F^*F) >= 0 for every finite Schwartz test sequence F in the field-word algebra, whose elements carry joint Schwartz tests multiplied by tensor product. In [L], Completed.isTheory gives Wightman.Realizes (meets, adj), and Fields.sees yields only `W.wordsPositive J := Analysis.NNKernel (W.kernel J)` with `kernel b c := W.expect (Sentence.rev J b ++ c)`. Here `expect` evaluates W.W on `Joint.materialize` of the letters' individual Test4s, so positivity covers finite combinations of product-test sentences only. No declaration in [L] extends this to general Joint n tests by density and continuity, so the claim stands as weaker. It is not a typo: [M] says plainly that the algebra uses joint Schwartz tests.

[M] prints W^xi(F^*F) >= 0 for every finite Schwartz test sequence F in the field-word algebra (joint tests). [L] Completed/Realizes give faithfulness, W1-W3, spectral condition and W_n (Surface.W, continuity `depends`), but positivity is only `Fields.sees : W.wordsPositive J`, i.e. NNKernel of W.kernel on Sentence (lists of letters (x, f : Test4), one test per letter via Joint.materialize). No declaration states nonnegativity for joint tests; the nearest ingredient is Next/BOUNDARY/Heights.lean `limiting_pair`/`heated`, giving inner products of joint-test vectors equal to W(joinedTest), from which positivity would follow by an unwritten step, so the claim stands.
